Thanks again for joining the demo today — really appreciated the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the procurement/commercial path so we can get you ready for an internal PO:

3) Attachments: I’m attaching the vendor setup packet (W-9 + onboarding checklist) so your procurement team can start vendor setup.

Requested from your side:
- Confirm whether you prefer PO (Net30) or card.
- If PO: billing contact and whether you need vendor onboarding form completed and returned.
- If marketplace: let us know and we’ll share next steps for registration.

I’ve CC’d Logan (sales ops) for invoicing logistics. I’ll follow up with our finance/ops if you want us to fill any vendor forms on your behalf.
